sources.title: nioncorp/nil-3b-gguf · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: nil-3b is a sovereign, offline-first 3-billion parameter language model quantized down to a 1.8GB GGUF footprint (q4_k_m). Developed by Nion Technologies, Inc., nil-3b is engineered specifically for low-resource environments, zero-bandwidth deployments, and edge computing hardware (ARM Cortex-A72, wearables, and low-power devices) across Africa.

sources.title: Nion Intelligence Labs | NIL-3B Sovereign Engine
sources.snippet: Autonomous offline AI models and decentralized edge intelligence optimized for Africa's low-bandwidth environments.
